gate: SinD Gate B: frozen Raj QGNN formal validation
question: Does the frozen Raj Weighted Multi-J QGNN outperform its matched Multi-J Johnson classical core on SinD-IC4?

preregistered_decision_rule.pass: both seeds improve ADE, FDE4, and J; each of the six origin-cluster bootstrap 95% CIs is strictly positive; no convergence warning
preregistered_decision_rule.conditional_pass: both-seed mean improves ADE, FDE4, and J and at least one seed improves all three, but a finite bootstrap or convergence confirmation remains
